title: Field-aware invert of a prior command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: A named invert of a prior committed command that is not the undo tip restores only that command's content write set when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later edit to any of those fields, or a tip / undo / redo / invertCommand target, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back.

Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot; version and revision are concurrency clocks and are reallocated on the invert commit. No new persistence table. The workbench exposes a dense command-id field and Invert button after the Markers panel and does not list every history row.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, splits, adds two left-side captions, moves the uninvolved right remnant, inverts the later SetCaptions (the extra cue is removed; the earlier cue, the moved remnant, and later markers stay), then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Invert after a followed clipLocal host move is UNDO_CONFLICT.

Already-delivered LiftClips/Cut, MoveClip, DeleteClip, TrimClip, split/interval/source-window, insert-move leave-gap, includeLinks=false, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. I-005 and I-010 stay partial.
